_comment: The Android build Eraya currently recommends. Read by the app from
https://eraya.app/app-version.json to show a dismissible 'there is a newer
1. Only ever name a release that is ALREADY PUBLISHED. The app turns this
into a download button, so naming an unpublished version points members
at a 404. Publish the GitHub release first, then change this.
2. downloadUrl must stay on https://eraya.app. The app rejects any other
origin on purpose -- it will not hand a member an APK from a host the
3. There is no minimum-version or force-update field, deliberately. Nothing
in this file can lock anybody out of their account; see version.ts.
4. This file is served as a static asset, so changing it needs a web deploy
(apps/web/** is in the deploy filter) and costs no Worker CPU.
NOTE ON v0.1.4: the published 0.1.4 build contains no version check at all,
so it will never read this file. The notice begins working with v0.1.5.
